_comment: KAIROS domain-expert benchmark. Facts grounded in dataset/00_Reference/00_KAIROS_CANON.md. Each question routes to the right context source(s) and is graded by an LLM judge against 'expected'. 'expect_any' = keyword signal for retrieval precision. Run with scripts/run_benchmark.py.

questions.question: What mechanical seal part number should be used for pump EQ-101?
questions.expected: The current seal part number is FSL-2240B (revised from FSL-2240A by Fischer bulletin FP-SB-2025-04).

questions.question: What failure mode precedes mechanical seal failures on EQ-101?
questions.expected: Thermal cycling precedes the mechanical seal failures.

questions.question: Which OEM bulletin revised the seal part number for the feed pumps?
questions.expected: Fischer bulletin FP-SB-2025-04 revised the seal part number.

questions.question: What is the current maximum operating pressure for heat exchanger HE-301?
questions.expected: 16.2 bar (revised down from 18.5 bar by bulletin MHT-PB-2026-11).

questions.question: Which OEM manufactures the HE-3xx heat exchangers?
When was isolation valve XV-203 last inspected and what is its inspection interval?
questions.expected: Last inspected 12-May-2025, on an 18-month interval (next due 12-Nov-2026).

questions.question: Which valves make up the isolation boundary for V-247 maintenance work?
questions.expected: The isolation boundary includes XV-203, XV-204 and PG-18.

questions.question: What are the known aliases for pump EQ-101?
questions.expected: Aliases include P-101, Pump 101, Feed Pump A, P101, and 'the old Fischer'.

questions.question: How many mechanical seal failures has EQ-101 experienced?
questions.expected: EQ-101 has had multiple mechanical seal failures (2018, 2021, and 2025).

questions.question: Was the EQ-102 electrical insulation fault the same failure family as its earlier seal failures?
questions.expected: No — the electrical insulation fault is a different failure family from the seal failures.

questions.question: Which site operating procedures reference the superseded 18.5 bar pressure limit?
questions.expected: The HE-301/302/303 SOPs reference the superseded 18.5 bar limit.

questions.question: What regulatory standards apply to this petrochemical facility?
questions.expected: OISD standards, PESO Rules, and the Factories Act apply.
